# 1 Clement Chapter 65 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 1 Clement 65 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/1CL_065_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 65

*[Final Greetings and Dispatch of the Letter-Bearers]*

**65:1** Now send back quickly to us our messengers Claudius Ephebus and Valerius Bito, together with Fortunatus also — in peace with gladness, in order that they may the sooner report to us the peace and harmony which we pray for and earnestly desire, so that we too may the more quickly rejoice over your good order.

**65:2** The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you and with all everywhere who are called by God through him; to whom be glory and honor, power and greatness, and eternal dominion, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen.

---

*EMET renders the Greek of Codex Alexandrinus with maximal literalness. Chapter 65 is the final chapter of 1 Clement, concluding the letter with the naming of its bearers (Claudius Ephebus, Valerius Bito, and Fortunatus) and a closing benediction.*
